test_title: PYST 04: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about Exercise CYCLONE, conducted in February 2025 is/are correct?

1. It was held at Mahajan Field Firing Ranges in Rajasthan.

2. The participating countries were India and Egypt.

3. The exercise focussed on artillery training of joint forces.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1 and 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Exercise CYCLONE** was conducted in February 2025 at the **Mahajan Field Firing Ranges in Rajasthan, India**.
 
• This bilateral military exercise was carried out jointly by **India and Egypt**, focusing on strengthening defense cooperation.
 
• The exercise aimed at **enhancing interoperability and operational preparedness** between the two nations' armed forces.
 
• Though it involved various military drills, the **focus was not specifically on artillery training**, making statement 3 incorrect.
 
• Hence, only statements 1 and 2 are correct, making **Option 2 the correct answer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahajan Field Firing Ranges (Rajasthan):**

 
 
• One of the largest and most advanced military training facilities in India.
 
• Used for conducting various military exercises, including multinational collaborations.
 
 
 
• **India-Egypt Defense Relations:**
 
 
• India and Egypt have a long-standing defense relationship, focusing on joint training, defense technology, and counter-terrorism operations.
 
• Egypt is a key partner for India in the Middle East and Africa region.
 
 
 
• **Joint Military Exercises:**
 
 
• Such exercises aim to improve coordination, interoperability, and operational capabilities of the participating nations.
 
• They also foster strategic and diplomatic ties between the countries involved.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Interoperability:**
 
 
• Interoperability ensures that forces from different nations can work together seamlessly during joint operations or multinational missions.
 
• It involves sharing knowledge, communication systems, and operational strategies.
